source_issues: The chief-complaint answer is 'No.' (pre-employment checkup with no complaint); the opening fact uses the visit reason from opening_scenario.
p016 sputum is 'Clear mucus.'; the note HPI says 'white mucus'.
p014 answer 'Yes, I am.' does not fit the sputum question grammatically (repeats the p008 answer form); read as yes.
p023 topic 'LutPPD' is an OCR artifact for 'Last PPD'.
The note HPI says the cough has had 'no recent change in frequency or severity'; the script only asks about change during the day (p010, p011). Added as from_note fact f014.
SP note 'Hold the physical burn request form in your hand' is garbled (probably 'physical exam request form').
e006 writes bowel sounds as '~BS x 4', an OCR artifact for '+BS x 4'.
The duration of coal-mine work is not given in the script or the note.
The raw exam checklist lists 'Cardiovascular evaluation: pulmonary auscultation, palpation, and percussion'; checklist items are not used as findings.
Challenging question has a doubled opening quotation mark in the source; cleaned in persona.
annotator_notes: Opening fact is taken from opening_scenario (pre-employment checkup) because the chief-complaint answer is 'No.'; that 'No' is kept as an absent fact (f001), even though he goes on to report a chronic cough.
Questions that ask about 'recently or in the past' (p001, p002) are kept as one absent fact each, with the time span in the text and temporality current.
p008 and p009 are merged into one cough fact so the 'several years' duration stays with the cough (rule 4); p010 and p011 say the same thing and are merged.
Mixed-item denials (p003, p005, p007, p019, p024, p025, p027) are split into one absent fact per item.
Coal-mine work is recorded as a past occupational exposure (subtype exposures); its duration is unknown.
GERD and asthma come from a single sentence in gold_additional_diagnosis and get one record each with the same rationale.
